recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1980s-style studio portrait featuring a woman in a multi-colored sweatshirt, framed by a thick red border and structured by geometric color fields and ultra-thin, large-scale typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between vertical yellow bar and white negative space
Diagonal color-blocking on clothing mirrored by horizontal bar in foreground
Thin-line typography overlapping the subject and background elements
High-contrast red outer frame containing all internal graphic divisions
coreInvariants: Vertical mustard-yellow column on the left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a woman, centered, leaning on a horizontal black rail.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's red and blue sweatshirt creates a central focal point against the neutral background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-right text, move down the vertical text on the left, and settle on the subject's profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper right quadrant provides breathing room for the display text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cobalt Blue and Teal (sweatshirt and skirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors against a neutral grey/white studio background.

letterConstructionRules: Large scale relative to the frame
Uniform stroke width with no modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertically stacked letters on the left side
Horizontal text at bottom with tight letter spacing

composition.position: Top right, bottom center, and left vertical edge

treatment.fill: Black or White depending on background contrast

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different orientations and colors.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman in 80s color-blocked clothing, leaning on a black rail. The background is split into a mustard yellow vertical bar on the left and a light grey/white gradient on the right. Surround the entire image with a thick solid red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, uppercase, hairline geometric sans-serif text. Stack one word vertically inside the yellow bar. Place another word in the top right white space. Place a third word horizontally across the bottom, overlapping the subject's skirt.

verificationChecks: Is the red border thick and solid?
Is there a vertical yellow bar on the left?
Does the text overlap the subject?

adjustableVariables: Specific word placement within the grid
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Precise alignment of text to the grid

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the hairline weight
Check that the red border is perfectly uniform
Verify the vertical text alignment is centered in the yellow bar
Confirm the color-blocking on the clothing is distinct and vibrant
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a thick [Color A] border with a [Color B] vertical sidebar, a studio portrait with [Color C] color-blocked fashion, and [Hairline Sans-Serif] typography integrated into the layout grid.
